promptLines: Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual Palari V2 character study

Primary request: Create one original Palari. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. A Palari is a small crafted ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.
Selected design:
- identity: swept ribbon crescent with a coral spine channel and resting arm
- silhouette: slender asymmetric crescent with a finished architectural sweep and a closed exterior cap
- crown: small directional soft overhang integrated into the anatomy
- opening: one long narrow recessed channel following the inner spine
- pose: one rounded arm resting along the opening and the other close to the body
- expression: gently amused through the eyes only, with no mouth
- exterior material: soft cool-neutral off-white porcelain, never pure digital white
- characteristic color: muted deep coral (#B94F48)
Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue: muted deep coral only, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark; no other colored hue
- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional narrow channel and no unrelated holes
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, coral iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy; one rests along the opening and the other remains close to the body
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy
- one compact six-aperture Palari seed mark on the lower front: four larger circular apertures at the corners of a compact rectangle plus exactly two smaller apertures centered vertically
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges
- overall body height at least 2.4 times visible face height
- crescent exterior sweep is fully closed and finished, never an upward-facing cavity
Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; direct 1:1 square, full figure visible and centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable porcelain form and inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, upward-facing cavity, open rim, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, appliance details, random holes, more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, household appliances, generic mascot smiles, any visible mouth, chibi proportions, horror, vacant doll eyes, circular aperture surrounding the face, text, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, duplicated characters.
prompts.resultReview: Strong closed porcelain crescent, single coral spine opening, no-mouth eyes, two fingerless arms, legless base, palette, and studio framing; all six seed apertures are the same size.

promptLines: Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square Palari mascot logo icon

Input image: Image 1 is an identity reference only, not an edit target. Derive a new symbol from its swept crescent shell, spine aperture, eyes, asymmetric arm pose, and seed family detail. Do not copy its alcove, lighting, porcelain material realism, camera scene, or shadow.

Primary request: Create one highly simplified IP mascot logo candidate, not a character illustration, for this exact Palari: a closed swept ribbon crescent with a small soft overhang, one long coral spine channel, two gently amused half-lidded eyes, one rounded arm resting across the opening and the other close to the shell, plus a compact seed detail. The closed crescent shell-and-aperture silhouette is the primary identity; the seed is secondary.
Background: fully opaque edge-to-edge uniform solid deep navy #172333, used only for the background.

Subject colors: exactly warm ivory #E9E6DF for the shell, arms, and eyelids; exactly muted deep coral #B94F48 for the single continuous aperture region, two minimal eye marks, and the six-aperture seed family detail. No other semantic colors.

Composition: upright mark emerging from the lower-left corner, filling 75–85% of the square. Preserve both rounded arms and the closed swept crescent identity without an open top. Square outer corners.

Complexity: approximately 6–10 broad rounded semantic shapes; one dominant continuous outer silhouette; one large continuous coral inner region; only two simple half-lidded eyes and no mouth. Keep the exact six seed apertures tiny and subordinate, grouped as four larger corner circles plus two smaller circles centered vertically.

Style: flat-first vector-friendly geometry with thick rounded weighty contours. Use only one uninterrupted, extremely subtle low-frequency same-family diffuse gradient inside each large IP color region, sharing an upper-left-to-lower-right direction; transition spans at least half the form; total lightness variation at most 0.08; micro-volume visible only at full size and disappearing at 32 × 32.
Small-size requirement: at 32 × 32, the swept crescent, coral spine, and crossing arm must remain immediately readable; the seed may compress but must not become the main logo.

Forbid: source scene, plaster alcove, floor, upward-facing cavity, open rim, realistic ceramic, texture, gloss, bevel, extrusion, strong 3D, clay toy rendering, cast shadow, contact shadow, highlight patches, closed shadow shapes, halo, vignette, background gradient, border, frame, App-icon mask, rounded canvas corners, transparency, text, watermark, mouth, eyebrows, nose, fingers, hands, legs, feet, clothing, machinery, extra openings, extra colors, decorative marks, thin lines, sharp points, centered sticker composition.
prompts.resultReview: The crescent identity and no-mouth expression are strong, but the background is vignetted, the mark floats rather than emerging from the corner, and the two small seed circles are horizontal.
